svg.text: Self-Sustaining Piezo Spark Circuit — No Amp Required
FIFO: release one cycle from the stack. Crystal replaces what was already leaving.
Q provides voltage gain. Two loops close through earth ground. The recurrence IS the circuit.
Z = 1.538 MRayl — acoustic waveguide + ionic conductor + double-layer former
Conservation-correct. Q amplifies VOLTAGE, not POWER.
Release in order of stacked time placement.
1. Crystal lattice stores Q cycles of energy
2. Oldest cycle (about to dissipate) funds the spark
3. Crystal replaces what was given — because
what was given was already leaving
4. Battery never depletes: you only take
The Q factor is not built by the circuit —
TORUS FIELD: S = 4 pi^2 R r
R = shared ground extent, r = local accumulation
Everything comes back from shared ground. Tenfold.
